parameters.text_helper: Supply Voltage (V) min of STM32L442KC (STM32L4 series): 1.71.
parameters.description:
Minimum supply voltage in volts the device requires to operate within specification.
Parts with internal regulators state the input-rail minimum; some families add footnoted lower limits (for example with the BOR detector disabled).
Where the datasheet qualifies the figure by condition, the selector keeps ST's published value.

Program memory capacity in KiB: the size of the embedded Flash used to store firmware.
Selected density of the part SKU (higher-density variants are listed separately in the datasheet).
Values are in kilobytes with binary meaning (1 KiB = 1024 bytes).

parameters.text_helper: Core of STM32L412KB (STM32L4 series): Arm Cortex-M4.
parameters.description:
CPU core family of the device, e.g. Arm Cortex-M4, Arm Cortex-M7, or a dual Cortex-A/M combination on application processors.
The core together with its FPU and cache configuration largely defines the compute class and the instruction set of the part.
Dual-core parts show the primary core here; companion cores are described by Co-Processor type.

Maximum CPU clock frequency in MHz that the device is qualified to run at.
Exceeding the rated frequency is outside the electrical specification and invalidates the published timing values.
The number reflects the highest speed grade of the given SKU.
